title: Whale reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='water' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#3ec9e0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#1f7fb0'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- whale body -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='60' rx='34' ry='22' fill='#2f8fd6'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='70' rx='26' ry='11' fill='#9fd8ef'/>
  <!-- head hump / brow -->
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='50' rx='15' ry='13' fill='#2f8fd6'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='52' r='4' fill='#e8f6ff'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='52' r='2' fill='#123a5c'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M75 60 q6 4 12 0' stroke='#9fd8ef' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M12 56 q-8 -8 -12 -4 q4 6 2 12 q6 2 10 -4 z' fill='#1f7fb0'/>
  <!-- pectoral fin -->
  <path d='M36 74 q-6 8 4 10 q8 0 8 -8 z' fill='#1f7fb0'/>
  <!-- spout -->
  <path d='M40 38 q-2 -8 3 -10 q1 5 5 6 q-2 -6 3 -9 q1 6 5 7 q-3 4 -4 8 z' fill='#bff0ff'/>
  <!-- book: cover -->
  <path d='M28 62 l22 -6 l0 20 l-22 6 z' fill='#e4572e'/>
  <path d='M50 56 l22 6 l0 20 l-22 -6 z' fill='#c8401c'/>
  <!-- pages -->
  <path d='M30 63 l18 -5 l0 16 l-18 5 z' fill='#fff3c4'/>
  <path d='M50 58 l18 5 l0 16 l-18 -5 z' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
  <!-- page lines -->
  <path d='M33 67 l12 -3' stroke='#c9a94e' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M33 71 l12 -3' stroke='#c9a94e' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 66 l12 3' stroke='#c9a94e' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 70 l12 3' stroke='#c9a94e' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 56 l0 20' stroke='#8a3314' stroke-width='1.5'/>
</svg>
